keyFindings.description: job_reason reads only each step's inline run: text, so an environment write it does not show passes. Reproduced in a copy of 14b78008: install-uv/action.yml (used by the test job before 'Test the Go daemon') given `echo "GOFLAGS=-tags=probe" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"`, plus packages/daemon/internal/record/zz_probe_test.go (//go:build probe) importing packages/envoy/racehelper -> check-ci-filters.sh exit 0, 'test: 3452 files, 0 uncovered', though `go test ./...` there compiles racehelper, outside the test filter. Same gap: a repo script that writes $GITHUB_ENV, `$(printenv GITHUB_ENV)`. Fix per the architect's choice: fall to everything (widens test and daemon-go-postgres-16, whose local actions already write $GITHUB_PATH), or pin each local action a reduced job uses by exact text, or state the boundary.

splitlines()/strip() disagree with bash. Reproduced: envoy-go natslive step run: 'go test -tags natslive ./internal/testnats/
# || (cd ../daemon && go build ./cmd/legion)
' -> check exit 0 ('envoy-go: 1941 files, 0 uncovered'); bash -e runs `$'#'` (not found) and then the hidden command (stub printed 'HIDDEN ran'). NBSP form passes too (deep reviewer). Fix: split only on 
, strip only space/tab; any byte outside printable ASCII, tab and 
 makes the script not simple; test cases for # and U+00A0#.

Only GO*/CGO_*/BASH_ENV/ENV names fall; HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and PATH reach GOFLAGS through Go's env file (or swap the go binary). Verified: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=<dir> go env GOFLAGS GOENV -> '-tags=natslive', '<dir>/go/env'; deep reviewer: a step env XDG_CONFIG_HOME plus a committed go/env with GOFLAGS=-overlay passes the check (exit 0). Fix: also fall on HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, PATH (or any name outside a short allowlist); one test case.
